title: Comprehensive metabolic profiling uncovers early variation and biomarkers of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma

evidence_spans.quote: untargeted metabolomic profiling of 329 serum samples revealed 1,431 metabolites
Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is a highly aggressive malignancy
metabolic alterations associated with the development and early progression of ESCC

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an original human cancer metabolomics/transcriptomics analysis, but it analyzes ESCC development and progression without an aging construct or aging-framed process.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Serum metabolites and potential early-ESCC biomarkers

evidence_spans.quote: untargeted metabolomic profiling of 329 serum samples revealed 1,431 metabolites
9 blood-based metabolites were identified as potential non-invasive biomarkers

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents completed metabolomic and multi-omics analyses, but describes profiling, biomarker identification, and predictive accuracy rather than a qualifying applied causal design.

directional_result_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract reports a current-result directional claim.
